prompt_text: What is the best home care agency in Pleasanton CA for an elderly parent?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” agency—the right fit depends on your parent’s needs, schedule, and budget. **I’d start by interviewing Right at Home Pleasanton and Senior Helpers Pleasanton**, then compare them with one smaller/local option such as **All Seasons Homecare**.

- **Right at Home Pleasanton** offers companionship and personal care, including help with mobility, meals, hygiene, transportation, and dementia-related needs; it advertises care from a few hours to 24/7. [Website](https://www.rightathome.net/pleasanton/about-us/areas-served/pleasanton) · (925) 401-5261  
- **Senior Helpers Pleasanton** lists dementia and Parkinson’s support, personal care, respite, and post-hospital transition services. [Website](https://www.seniorhelpers.com/ca/pleasanton/) · (925) 392-7643  
- **All Seasons Homecare** offers hourly and live-in nonmedical care, respite, and help with daily activities. A review listing shows 4.5/5 from four reviews—useful as a starting point, but a small sample. [Reviews and services](https://www.caring.com/senior-care/california/pleasanton/all-seasons-homecare-94566)

Before choosing, ask each agency for its **current California Home Care Organization license**, caregiver screening and training practices, backup coverage, minimum hours, total rates and fees, and how it handles a poor caregiver match. Request a care assessment and references, and make sure the written plan clearly distinguishes nonmedical help from any skilled nursing your parent may need.
